note: The three job board providers the fetch may read, and whether their terms allow it. owner/fetch.py refuses a provider that isn't marked allowed, or whose terms were checked more than max_age_days before the run. Filled in from the terms check on 2026-11-09 (reader/NOTES_JOB_BOARD_TERMS_2026-11-09.md, recorded in DATA.md). Every verdict was 'unclear': the documents neither grant nor forbid a third party's read, and none binds a non-customer, so each is allowed with the conditions listed, which the fetcher and the page enforce.

greenhouse.status: allowed with conditions: the terms are silent on third-party reads
conditions: link every posting to its absolute_url
date by first_published and label updated_at as an update

lever.status: allowed with conditions: the terms are silent on third-party reads
conditions: at most one request a second (reported Crawl-delay 1)
no model training on the content

ashby.status: allowed with conditions: the terms are silent on third-party reads
conditions: drop every posting with isListed false
treat a 404 as no board, never scrape the hosted page
honor api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt, read at the start of the run
no implied license to its marks
